entry.title: Weekly GitHub traffic report: 2 Nov 2026 to 8 Nov 2026
entry.summary: From 2 Nov 2026 to 8 Nov 2026, public repositories received 139 views and 2,932 clones. The busiest day was Wednesday 2026-11-04 with 59 views. 41 repositories received at least one view, and musfira-ai-swift-15-27b-swift-qwen-just-got-faster led with 14 (10% of the total). 19 new repositories were created during the week.
